title: Application Launcher Settings: "Show buttons for" can be confusing
line: The Application Launcher settings now say which actions go into the separate menu when you pick Power or Session for the buttons.
explanation: "Show buttons for" turns the chosen group (Power or Session) into icon buttons and puts the other group in a menu labelled with its name. With captions off, the only visible word in the footer is that menu's label, so picking Power made it look like Session had been selected. The settings page gave no hint of this. The change adds a small note below the options saying which group is shown in a separate menu, hidden for "Power and session".

commits.message:
applets/kickoff: explain where the other actions go in settings

With "Show buttons for" set to Power or Session, the other group ends up
in a separate menu, which made it look like the setting was swapped when
captions were off. Add a short note below the options saying so.

BUG: 528030

patches.diff:
From 05a7ffa63b57eb4963528608aae349e996afece5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:36:41 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kickoff: explain where the other actions go in
 settings

With "Show buttons for" set to Power or Session, the other group ends up
in a separate menu, which made it look like the setting was swapped when
captions were off. Add a short note below the options saying so.

BUG: 528030
---
 applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml | 11 +++++++++++
 1 file changed, 11 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml b/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
index 025cba4c49..4147b4e2e7 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
@@ -286,6 +286,17 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             checked: Plasmoid.configuration.primaryActions === index
         }
 
+        QQC2.Label {
+            Layout.fillWidth: true
+            Layout.maximumWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 25
+            visible: powerActionsButton.checked || sessionActionsButton.checked
+            text: powerActionsButton.checked
+                ? i18nc("@info", "Session actions are shown in a separate menu.")
+                : i18nc("@info", "Power actions are shown in a separate menu.")
+            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
+            font: Kirigami.Theme.smallFont
+        }
+
         QQC2.CheckBox {
             id: showActionButtonCaptions
             text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show action button captions")
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: Power selected, no explanation of where the Session actions go
Fix: a note says Session actions are shown in a separate menu
Master, reporter's case: Session selected, captions off; the footer only shows a "Power" menu
Fix, same settings: the note says Power actions are in a separate menu, matching the footer

reviews.text: Adding an inline small-font QQC2.Label below the 'Show buttons for:' radio group clarifies where the unselected action group appears and follows the exact layout, styling, and i18n pattern of the existing note in ConfigGeneral.qml. Both strings are complete translatable sentences, the label hides cleanly for 'Power and session', and screenshots confirm a tidy result.

Tracey (c1) confirmed the behaviour is intentional and asked for help text saying the unselected group becomes a captioned menu, and this adds exactly that under the 'Show buttons for' radios. It follows the page's existing small-font note pattern (maximumWidth 25 gridUnits, smallFont) and is hidden for 'Power and session'. The QML is trivial and binds to the existing radio ids, and after-2.png shows the note matching the footer's 'Power' menu in the reporter's Session + no-captions case. Nit: the note is aligned with the radio indicators rather than their text, as the other note on the page is.
